arguments.summary: Decision: develop differentiated, conditional 21/63-session research theses for ANET, QQQ, MU, META and NVDA versus the fixed SPY and sector benchmarks, without rankings or calibrated forecasts. Grouped neutral assignments have been accepted for company fundamentals/QQQ look-through, macro, technicals, and geopolitics. Commodities is omitted because no direct commodity-price transmission channel has yet been identified as material relative to the assigned semiconductor, networking, platform, macro and policy work.

claims.text: The eventual assessment will remain conditional until the assigned research establishes company catalysts, QQQ holdings exposure, macro/policy transmission, and price-context evidence for the stated 21/63-session horizons.
